name: Back to Darnassus
summary: After meeting the Great Bear Spirit, a young night elf druid returns to Darnassus. The initiate has left Moonglade and now reports to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave for practical shapeshifting trials.

sections.title: A Journey Between Sanctuaries
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze sends the initiate from Nighthaven back to Darnassus after the meeting with the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade. The journey joins two sanctuaries: Moonglade, where the young druid has communed with the spirit, and the unsettled world beyond. In Darnassus, local mentors watch over Teldrassil and guide the next stage of training.

sections.title: The Path of the Claw
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker waits in the Cenarion Enclave, where he guards nature even as its balance falters. The Great Bear Spirit's blessing is only the first step. Mathrengyl prepares the initiate for trials of body and heart, to give physical form to the spirit's fierce ancestral wisdom.

faq.q: Why do I need to return to Darnassus?
faq.answer: Moonglade is where you commune with the Great Bear Spirit, while your mentor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, waits in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. He guides the practical tests that help you master your new power.
Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a seasoned night elf druid trainer in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. He guides young initiates along the Way of the Claw and in mastering bear form.

faq.q: How do I get back to Darnassus from Moonglade?
faq.answer: Silva Fil'naveth, the hippogryph master in southwestern Nighthaven, can fly you across the sea to Rut'theran Village. From there, a portal leads up into Darnassus.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Mathrengyl?
aliases: next quest after back to darnassus
faq.answer: Mathrengyl gives you your first true test of purpose: face Lunaclaw at the Moonkin Stone east of Auberdine in Darkshore. The trial proves whether your body and heart are ready to wield bear form.

faq.q: What is the Path of the Claw?
faq.answer: The Path of the Claw is a druidic tradition that channels the bear's ferocity, resilience, and strength through communion with ancient primal spirits.

faq.q: Why does Dendrite mention balance faltering near Darnassus?
faq.answer: Teldrassil is young and lacks the Dragon Aspects' blessing, leaving its boughs vulnerable to strange corruptions, furbolg madness, and encroaching darkness. Druids in the Cenarion Enclave fight these threats.

angles.text: For a young druid, this journey marks the passage from spiritual communion to physical shapeshifting.
As a night elf, you travel between Moonglade, an ancient sanctuary, and Teldrassil, the newly planted World Tree. The journey joins millennia of kaldorei heritage with your duties today.
